content: In our setups, we use a marked target copy, viewed as a fake source, which a generator encodes so as to fool a discriminator trained to distinguish a fake from a natural source. Our architecture contains two distinct encoders, one for the natural source and one for the pseudo-source. The latter acts as the generator ( INLINEFORM0 ) in the GAN framework, computing a representation of the pseudo-source that is then input to a discriminator ( INLINEFORM1 ), which has to sort natural from artificial encodings. INLINEFORM2 assigns a probability of a sentence being natural.
